title: Abyssals v0.90.44 — Eamon's Field Journal
notes: Adds Eamon's Field Journal to the in-game Start menu. Tracks seen species from revealed wild and trainer encounters, remembers species ever owned across evolution, rehoming and permadeath, distinguishes living catches, and shows habitat clues, typings, natural and individual growth, evolutions, abilities and learnsets as discovered. Removes old external field guide, growth report and move studio links from the Abyssals screen. Backfills older saves from party, reserves, memorial and evolution history without inventing earlier unseen encounters. Keeps the offline PWA and Android package identity/signing.
